recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed in core unless a future work-group decision changes RelatedPerson.address cardinality again.
issue_request: FHIR-6972 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core RelatedPerson change request from the PA work group asking to change RelatedPerson.address cardinality from 0..1 to 0..* because a related person can have more than one address.
initial_application: The request was applied by git commit 20db0dd4d99c6017d648d6ed8b0b7a87da7390b9, "Tracker #6972 Address cardinality update", which changed the historical RelatedPerson spreadsheet row from 0..1 to 0..*. Later source refactoring carried that cardinality into the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: RelatedPerson is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini as resource relatedperson=RelatedPerson, PA-owned, and approved. The current source/relatedperson/structuredefinition-RelatedPerson.xml defines RelatedPerson.address with min 0 and max *, and the current search parameter bundle consistently targets RelatedPerson.address. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The combined branch now has an empty no-change audit commit documenting that the current source already matches the Jira decision.
